title: Ghost Line race file
description: One directed pair: its 1938 clock, eligible trips, and one race row per slider minute.

sources.description: Maps blocks of this file to source-ID arrays from the index.json catalog. y1938 is covered by the 1938 diagram and timetable. today is covered by the MTA GTFS feed and the method. races is derived from y1938 and today and is covered by the diagram, timetable, GTFS feed and method. radius_m is a method parameter. Every other numeric top-level field must be listed here explicitly; the emitter checks coverage and ID resolution.

direction.description: Direction of travel along the line.

inferred.description: True if either endpoint uses an inferred position.

feed_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the pinned GTFS zip.

today.description: Today's eligible one-seat trips for this pair.

races.description: One race row for every whole minute from 09:00 to 13:52 (293 rows). Rows before covered_from repeat the covered_from race, with start equal to covered_from and before_table true.

SourceIds.description: Nonempty list of source IDs from the index.json catalog.

ride_min.description: In-vehicle ride time in minutes (sum of inter-corner minutes).

covered_from.description: First passing time at the origin corner (HH:MM).

passes.description: All scheduled passing times at the origin corner (HH:MM), strictly increasing.

gap_min.description: Smallest gap in minutes between consecutive 1938 passes at the origin corner in [09:00, 14:00).

gap_max.description: Largest gap in minutes between consecutive 1938 passes at the origin corner in [09:00, 14:00).

sources.description: Source URLs keyed by field name.

gap_min.description: Smallest gap in minutes between consecutive eligible departures in [09:00, 14:00). Null only when trips is empty.

gap_max.description: Largest gap in minutes between consecutive eligible departures in [09:00, 14:00). Null only when trips is empty.

window_from.description: Start of the window the bus gaps cover (HH:MM).

window_to.description: End of the window the bus gaps cover (HH:MM), excluded.

route_names.description: The distinct display route names (route_display) of the trips in the list, in order of first appearance.

trips.description: Every eligible trip departing the boarding stop at or after 09:00, in departure order, through the third trip after the last trip any race row uses. i is the 0-based index in this list.

i.description: 0-based index used to reference this trip from race rows.

route_display.description: Route name as the card shows it, for example 'CityLink Lime'.

headsign.description: Trip headsign as it appears in the GTFS feed.

dep.description: Departure time from the boarding stop (HH:MM:SS; hours may exceed 23 for GTFS overnight trips).

arr.description: Arrival time at the alighting stop (HH:MM:SS).

ride_min.description: In-vehicle ride time in minutes (arr − dep), stored to 3 decimal places.

walk_m.description: Geodesic walk distance from the corner to this stop, in metres.

walk_min.description: Estimated walk time in minutes (walk_m × 1.3 ÷ 1.2 ÷ 60), to 3 decimal places.

start.description: Actual race start time (HH:MM); equals t unless t is before covered_from.

before_table.description: True when t is before covered_from (the slider is in the 'before midday table' state).

today.description: Today's side of the race, or null when no one-seat ride exists.

margin.description: Absolute difference between the two totals in minutes. Present for '1938', 'today', and 'photo_finish'; absent for 'no_one_seat_ride'.

dep.description: Departure time of the 1938 car from the origin corner (HH:MM).

wait.description: Wait time in minutes from start to the car's departure. Never exceeds 8.

trip.description: Index into the trips array (the 'i' field of the chosen trip).

wait.description: Wait time in minutes from start to the moment the rider can board (dep − start − access_min).

total.description: Total time in minutes from start to arrival at the destination corner (arr + egress_min − start).
